CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (
    id,
    username,
    display_name,
    is_public,
    created_at
  )
  values (
    new.id,
    new.email,
    new.email,
    true,
    now()
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$
